intro: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens, a version with enhanced safeguards for users aged 13 to 17, featuring content protections against self-harm and sexual content. Anthropic's run rate exceeded $65 billion as the company prepares for an IPO valued at $2 trillion, betting on sustained AI demand and the ability to reach $200 billion in revenue by 2028. OpenAI is also rewriting its safety framework after a security breach exposed vulnerabilities, with new monitoring systems adding approximately 20 percent computational overhead.
